BiblicalUsage: This word names the idols, the carved images men worshipped, and the Bible follows them to their end. The Philistines cut off Saul's head and stripped his armour and sent word to the house of their idols, David's men burned the idols the Philistines left behind, Hosea says Israel made idols from their silver and gold, and Judah forsook the house of the LORD to serve groves and idols.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the idols always end the same way, stripped, burned, or abandoned, because they are the work of men's hands and cannot save. The house of God was forsaken for them, and I hold that every idol still asks for the worship that belongs to God alone.
